_note: Verified, credited one-liners for the Field Notes closer. Every text is copied exactly from source_url, which was fetched and checked to contain it. Never add, reword or invent a joke; a fresh real post from the day's humor voices may win instead (tools/fn_jokes.py). Tone: clean, Christian-friendly, smart, dry, tech or dad humor.

jokes.text: I have a large seashell collection which I keep scattered on the beaches all over the world. Maybe you've seen it.
jokes.author: Steven Wright

jokes.text: When I first read the dictionary, I thought it was a long poem about everything.
jokes.author: Steven Wright

jokes.text: I went to a museum where they had all the heads and arms from the statues that are in all the other museums.
jokes.author: Steven Wright

jokes.text: Everywhere is walking distance if you've got the time.
jokes.author: Steven Wright

jokes.text: I bought some powdered water, but I don't know what to add.
jokes.author: Steven Wright

jokes.text: A lot of people are afraid of heights; not me, I'm afraid of widths.
jokes.author: Steven Wright

jokes.text: I bought a new camera. It's very advanced. You don't even need it.
jokes.author: Steven Wright

jokes.text: I've just been on a once-in-a-lifetime holiday. I'll tell you what, never again.
jokes.author: Tim Vine

jokes.text: I've decided to sell my Hoover – well, it was just collecting dust.
jokes.author: Tim Vine

jokes.text: Always do right. This will gratify some people, and astonish the rest.
jokes.author: Mark Twain
jokes.where: To the Young People's Society, Greenpoint Presbyterian Church, Brooklyn (16 February 1901)

jokes.text: IF YOU ever drop your keys into a river of molten lava, let 'em go, because man, they're gone.
jokes.author: Jack Handey

jokes.text: We did long for the pitter-patter of little feet, so we decided to buy a dog. Cheaper, and… get more feet.
jokes.author: Rita Rudner
jokes.where: Dr. Katz, Professional Therapist, “Real Estate” [2.02] (29 October 1995)

jokes.text: The electric toothbrush—what, is brushing your teeth too strenuous an exercise?
jokes.author: Tim Hawkins
